summary: Pearson PLC filed a Form 6-K disclosing that Cevian Capital II GP Limited crossed a threshold on 22-Apr-2026, now holding 19.207% voting rights (116,765,346 shares), up from 18.090%. This is a notification of a major holding under UK rules (mapped to US Schedule 13D filing). Cevian Capital is a well-known activist investor. The filing does not specify price, premium, or board recommendation. Cevian may push for strategic changes such as operational improvement or M&A. Watch for shareholder proposals, board seat demands, or management engagement.
